name: Ea — Sword of Rupture
description: Gilgamesh's three-segment rotating divine weapon unleashes Enuma Elish, compressing turbulent forces into ruptures that crush space-time.

name: IXA
description: Arima's S+ koukaku quinque is a lance that extends for lethal stabs and reconfigures into a powerful defensive form.

name: Owl
description: An SSS ukaku quinque built from the Owl's kakuhou; a huge blade firing Rc projectiles and even striking through remote blade materialization.

name: Narukami
description: Arima's rapier-handle weapon deploys four satellite panels to launch homing lightning-like Rc blasts or combine into a slicing blade.

name: Ginkui
description: Urie's katana can expand into enormous devouring tentacles, split into multi-mouth traps, and erupt from a target after impaling it.

name: Arata Joker
description: An advanced armored quinque that amplifies Suzuya's mobility and strength while providing claw blades and back-mounted attack appendages.

name: T-Human
description: Hairu Ihei's satellite-panel quinque fires either a concentrated Rc-cell beam or a broad dispersed volley.

name: Amatsu
description: Akira Mado's rare chimera quinque combines Rc types and changes from a stabbing weapon into a flexible whip-like form.

name: 13's Jason
description: Suzuya's dramatic rinkaku quinque forged from Yamori is a large brutal, scythe-like cutting weapon.

name: Arata II
description: An advanced full-body quinque armor designed to endure attacks from extremely dangerous ghouls at substantial physical cost.

name: Gáe Bolg
description: Cú Chulainn's cursed thrust reverses cause and effect so a pierced heart becomes the established outcome before the spear moves.

name: Excalibur
description: Artoria's sacred sword converts tremendous magical power into a concentrated torrent of golden light.

name: Kanshou and Bakuya
description: EMIYA's paired black and white swords attract one another, enabling returning throws and chained pincer attacks.

name: Enkidu — Chain of Heaven
description: Gilgamesh's divine chains bind gods and heroic spirits; they become harder to escape as the target's divinity increases.

name: Rule Breaker
description: Medea's ceremonial dagger can break magical contracts and cancel certain magecraft on direct application.

name: Fragarach
description: Bazett's counterattack weapon reverses attack order against a decisive enemy move, striking before that move occurs.

name: Rhongomyniad
description: A sacred lance associated with anchoring the world's layers; releasing its power manifests devastating divine radiance.

name: Vasavi Shakti
description: Karna sacrifices his golden protection to use a god-slaying divine spear attack of extraordinary destructive output.

name: Balmung
description: Siegfried's dragon-slaying sword releases a huge energy wave especially suited to fighting dragons.

name: Gáe Dearg
description: Diarmuid's crimson spear severs the flow of magic at its point of contact, penetrating enchanted defenses.

name: Gáe Buidhe
description: Diarmuid's golden spear inflicts a lasting curse that stops conventional magical treatment from healing its wounds.

name: Azrael
description: First Hassan's greatsword bears a death-associated power; even ordinary strikes carry a possibility of instant death.

name: Black Barrel
description: A specialized conceptual anti-immortal weapon; versions exploit the mortality of otherwise extraordinarily difficult targets.

name: Harpe
description: Perseus's divine sickle is linked to negating certain immortal or restorative properties of its victims.

name: Kyōka Suigetsu
description: Aizen's Zanpakutō places witnesses to its release under complete hypnosis, manipulating all five senses.

name: Ichimonji
description: Ichibē's brush-blade spreads black ink to erase names and their associated power, then writes new ones.

name: Zangetsu / Tensa Zangetsu
description: Ichigo's signature blade concentrates spiritual power into Getsuga Tenshō slashes; Bankai compresses power for astonishing speed.

name: Ryūjin Jakka / Zanka no Tachi
description: Yamamoto's fire sword creates enormous flames; Bankai condenses its vast heat and can manifest additional deadly fire techniques.

name: Senbonzakura
description: Byakuya's blade dissolves into countless tiny petal-like blades he can guide as blades, walls or storms.

name: Katen Kyōkotsu
description: Shunsui's twin blades turn children's games into binding combat rules; Bankai forces opponents through a deadly theatrical tragedy.

name: Benihime
description: Urahara's versatile Zanpakutō releases energy techniques; its Bankai restructures things within reach, including bodies.

name: Nozarashi
description: Kenpachi's monstrous sword and Bankai unleash overwhelming cleaving force and savage physical power.

name: Sakanade
description: Shinji's sword inverts directional perception, making up/down and left/right feel backwards; Bankai confuses friend and foe.

name: Ashisogi Jizō
description: Mayuri's blade injects a paralysis-inducing toxin, while its grotesque Bankai spreads deadly poison.

name: Hyōrinmaru
description: Hitsugaya's ice dragon Zanpakutō freezes and controls water and ice, escalating dramatically with Bankai.

name: Wabisuke
description: Each strike doubles the weight of the object hit, making shields and swords unmanageable with repeated contact.

name: Inverted Spear of Heaven
description: Toji's special-grade dagger forcibly cancels cursed techniques upon contact, including otherwise untouchable defenses.

name: Split Soul Katana
description: A katana that bypasses physical toughness to cut the target's soul; full potential demands perception of souls.

name: Chain of a Thousand Miles
description: A chain that can continue extending indefinitely so long as one end remains unseen.

name: Playful Cloud
description: A three-part special-grade staff with no inherent cursed technique; impact scales with the user's raw physical power.

name: Sword of Extermination
description: Mahoraga's arm-mounted blade emits positive energy, especially dangerous to cursed spirits.

name: Samehada
description: A sentient sharkskin sword that eats chakra, shares stolen energy with its owner, heals wounds and can fuse with them.

name: Sword of Totsuka
description: Itachi's spectral Susanoo sword seals anyone it pierces into a spirit prison associated with a gourd.

name: Yata Mirror
description: Itachi's spiritual shield shifts its chakra nature to counter incoming attacks; its invulnerability is described in-universe.

name: Kusanagi — Orochimaru's sword
description: A supernatural straight sword that can extend, move on command and pierce remarkably tough targets.

name: Hiramekarei
description: A twin-handled blade that stores chakra and emits it as large shaped weapons such as a hammer.

name: Kubikiribōchō
description: Zabuza's enormous executioner's sword can regenerate lost metal using iron from victims' blood.

name: Gunbai
description: Madara's giant war fan can redirect attacks through the Uchiha Reflection technique.

name: Murasame
description: Akame's cursed katana kills living targets after even a shallow cut via a rapidly spreading poisonous curse.

name: Incursio
description: Living dragon-based armor grants strength and stealth and gradually evolves to adapt to extreme threats.

name: Yatsufusa
description: Kurome's sword can control a limited number of corpses as combat puppets.

name: Pumpkin
description: Mine's rifle fires powerful energy blasts that grow stronger when its user is in greater danger.

name: Cross Tail
description: Lubbock's spool of super-strong wire forms traps, cutting threads, restraints and improvised weapons.

name: Grand Chariot
description: Wave's armored Teigu emphasizes exceptional protective strength and mobility.

name: Extase
description: A huge bladed Teigu with fearsome cutting power, especially effective against other Imperial Arms.

name: Tessaiga
description: A fang-forged sword that evolves through absorbed powers: giant shockwaves, attack reflection, diamond volleys and a slash into the netherworld.

name: Tenseiga
description: Sesshōmaru's sword can restore the recently dead under certain conditions and later gain an underworld-cutting attack.

name: Bakusaiga
description: Sesshōmaru's sword spreads destructive corrosion through anything connected to the wound, preventing easy regeneration.

name: Crown Clown / Sword of Exorcism
description: Allen's Innocence becomes claw, armor and a sword designed to exorcise the Noah-related darkness within enemies.

name: Judgment
description: Cross Marian's enchanted handgun fires pursuing bullets that keep seeking a selected target.

name: Spirit Spear Chastiefol
description: King's floating Sacred Tree spear assumes many forms including spear, guardian beast, protective flower and countless small blades.

name: Lostvayne
description: Meliodas's short sacred sword enables physical clones of himself with diminished strength.

name: War Hammer Gideon
description: Diane's vast hammer magnifies earth magic and can redirect magical energy into the ground.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Guts's colossal slab of iron becomes steeped in supernatural battles, allowing it to affect astral beings as well as physical enemies.

name: Crescent Rose
description: Ruby's high-caliber sniper rifle folds into a massive scythe with recoil-assisted mobility and long-range fire.

name: Myrtenaster
description: Weiss's rapier holds a rotating Dust chamber for elemental attacks and support effects.

name: Gambol Shroud
description: Blake's weapon switches among sword, pistol, sickle and tethered grappling forms.

name: Ember Celica
description: Yang's bracelets expand into powerful shotgun gauntlets that drive explosive punches.

name: Magnhild
description: Nora's colossal hammer converts into a grenade launcher for close- and long-range destruction.

name: Anesidora
description: Velvet's weapon stores photographic imprints of other combat weapons, creating hard-light copies.

name: Gianduja
description: Coco's stylish handbag transforms into a huge rotating-barrel machine gun.

name: Ruyi Bang and Jingu Bang
description: Sun's staff breaks into nunchaku and paired shotgun forms, combining melee reach and gunfire.

name: Grass Sword
description: A cursed blade bonds to Finn, hides around his arm, regenerates and can turn into living aggressive vegetation.

name: Finn Sword
description: A sword containing another timeline's Finn; its unusually personal connection later matters to Fern's origin.

name: Demon Blood Sword
description: A blade forged from demon blood, with magical properties and a sinister link to the demon Kee-Oth.

name: Yamato
description: Vergil's demonic katana cuts dimensional boundaries and can divide a person into separate human and demonic aspects.

name: Rebellion
description: Dante's inherited sword has a unifying power tied to his demonic identity and becomes central to his transformation.

name: Devil Sword Dante
description: Dante's awakened blade channels his deeper devil power and manifests spectral summoned swords around him.

name: Red Queen
description: Nero's motorcycle-inspired sword revs its Exceed engine to ignite and amplify swings.

name: Blue Rose
description: Nero's custom double-barrel revolver fires two shots in rapid succession and can charge empowered bullets.

name: Pandora
description: A demonic suitcase becomes a vast collection of gun configurations, from cannon to missile platform.

name: King Cerberus
description: A transforming three-section weapon switches among ice nunchaku, fire staff and lightning three-section staff.

name: Kalina Ann
description: Lady's enormous bayonet-equipped rocket launcher is built for heavy demon-killing firepower.

name: Holy Moonlight Sword
description: Ludwig's greatsword transforms to release mystical moonlight arcs and ranged energy waves.

name: Burial Blade
description: Gehrman's weapon converts from a curved sword into a long sweeping scythe.

name: Chikage
description: A katana that draws on its wielder's blood to gain powerful blood attacks while steadily consuming their health.

name: Whirligig Saw
description: A heavy mace becomes a motorized saw that repeatedly shreds whatever it contacts.

name: Simon's Bowblade
description: A curved sword unfolds into a bow that launches deadly blood-powered arrows.

name: Bloodletter
description: A mace becomes a blood-soaked spiked weapon after harming its owner; its attacks can inflict Frenzy.

name: Amygdalan Arm
description: A severed Great One limb used as a club comes alive in extended form, writhing and striking like a whip.

name: Threaded Cane
description: A refined walking cane becomes an extended serrated whip for cutting through packs of beasts.

name: Maliketh's Black Blade
description: A giant sword infused with a fragment of Destined Death reduces maximum health and causes lingering loss of life.

name: Dark Moon Greatsword
description: Ranni's magical greatsword charges with lunar frost, releasing luminous moonlight waves from heavy swings.

name: Blasphemous Blade
description: Rykard's grotesque sword heals its bearer when enemies die and sends a fiery life-stealing wave.

name: Starscourge Greatsword
description: Radahn's twin greatswords manipulate gravity to pull enemies inward before a spectacular area attack.

name: Godslayer's Greatsword
description: The Godskin-associated colossal blade ignites black flame with sustained burning damage.

name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
description: Mohg's trident invokes bloodflame through an unseen divinity, creating repeated area-wide blood eruptions.

name: Sacred Relic Sword
description: A divine blade unleashes a broad golden wave that travels through the ground in a sweeping arc.

name: Sword of Night and Flame
description: An ancient dual-power sword attacks with both a magical beam and sweeping fire.

name: Hand of Malenia
description: Malenia's elegant katana delivers exceptionally fast chained slashes through Waterfowl Dance.

name: Rellana's Twin Blades
description: Paired swords combine glintstone magic with fire, alternating blue magical arcs and red flame strikes.

name: Artorias's Greatsword
description: Artorias's abyss-touched greatsword and its variants carry the legend of a knight who fought the Abyss.

name: Moonlight Greatsword
description: A legendary dragon-associated sword whose charged swings release moonlight energy projectiles.

name: Farron Greatsword
description: A huge greatsword paired with a dagger lets the wielder perform sliding, spinning acrobatics.

name: Frayed Blade
description: Midir's katana releases dark destructive slashes and sweeping darkness-infused attacks.

name: Mortal Blade
description: A crimson katana able to sever immortality, allowing the permanent death of beings otherwise unable to die.

name: Loaded Umbrella
description: A shinobi prosthetic folds into an armored umbrella for blocking, spinning defense and upgraded counterattacks.

name: Leviathan Axe
description: Kratos's frost axe freezes enemies and returns to his hand whenever summoned.

name: Blades of Chaos
description: Kratos's chained blades ignite with primordial fire and extend his reach for sweeping attacks.

name: Draupnir Spear
description: A magical ring generates endless copies of a spear that Kratos can plant and detonate.

name: Blade of Olympus
description: A god-forged sword that channels enormous divine power and has been used against Titans and gods.

name: OutRage / Fireseal
description: A powerful magic weapon system; Fireseal amplifies fire and forms part of Sol Badguy's signature armaments.

name: Junkyard Dog
description: Sol's huge weapon combines sacred components, functioning as a blunt sword and an extremely powerful energy cannon.

name: Thunderseal
description: Ky Kiske's sacred blade amplifies and releases powerful lightning magic.

name: Bolverk
description: Noel's paired Nox Nyctores handguns convert their form and fire destructive magical bullets.

name: Yukianesa
description: Jin's Nox Nyctores sword spreads severe cold and ice, while influencing its wielder's behavior.

name: Aramasa
description: Hakumen's large white blade is a Nox Nyctores capable of cutting through extraordinary targets.

name: Nightblood
description: A sentient Awakened sword made to destroy evil; it consumes vast supernatural energy and can devour wielders as well as enemies.

name: Shardblade
description: Magical giant swords cut through nonliving matter and sever a living being's soul connection, disabling limbs instead of leaving ordinary wounds.

name: Jezrien's Honorblade
description: A legendary Honorblade that grants access to the Windrunner Surges of Adhesion and Gravitation, even without a spren bond.

name: Sting
franchise: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien
description: Frodo and Bilbo's Elvish blade glows blue when Orcs are near, warning its wielder of danger.

name: Andúril
franchise: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien
description: The reforged sword of Elendil, symbolizing Aragorn's royal heritage and renowned for its extraordinary workmanship.

name: Morgul-knife
franchise: The Lord of the Rings / Tolkien
description: A Nazgûl's cursed dagger leaves a fragment in the victim that can draw them toward wraithhood.

name: Darksaber
description: A rare black-bladed lightsaber; a symbol of Mandalorian leadership and an unusual energy blade used in duels.

name: Kylo Ren's Crossguard Saber
description: An unstable kyber crystal requires side vents that produce two dangerous crossguard plasma blades.

name: Lightsaber Whip
description: A rare flexible lightsaber variant capable of striking around guards in unpredictable arcs.

name: The Emperor's Sword
description: A blazing psychic sword that can grant daemons True Death instead of merely banishing them into the Warp.

name: Drach'nyen
description: Abaddon's powerful daemon sword houses a terrifying Warp entity and is lethal to mortal and supernatural enemies.

name: Daemon Weapons
description: Weapons containing daemonic entities offer terrible power while risking corruption or domination of their bearer.

name: Energy Sword
description: A Covenant or Banished melee weapon forms lethal plasma blades for terrifying close-range cuts and lunges.

name: Gravity Hammer
description: A massive hammer discharges gravity impulses on impact, launching soldiers and even vehicles.

name: Needler
description: Launches tracking crystalline needles that can combine in a target and explode.

name: Cindershot
description: A Forerunner hardlight grenade launcher whose alternate mode allows mid-flight projectile guidance.

name: BFG 9000
description: Fires a huge Argent energy projectile that lashes nearby enemies with deadly beams across its flight path.

name: Crucible
description: The Slayer's glowing Argent blade slices through powerful demons, with special importance against Titans.

name: Unmaykr
description: A rapid-firing Maykr weapon unleashing sustained energy spread against crowds and hard targets.

name: Service Weapon
description: A supernatural firearm tied to the FBC Directorship; it changes between pistol, scattergun, beam-like and explosive weapon forms.

name: One Thousand Voices
description: An exotic fusion rifle that emits a continuous destructive beam and causes delayed explosive detonations along its path.

name: Graviton Lance
description: A cosmic pulse rifle firing miniature black-hole-themed rounds, causing enemies to detonate and produce tracking void projectiles.

name: Whisper of the Worm
description: An exotic sniper rifle whose origins are bound to the Worm God Xol; precision hits sustain its supernatural firing cycle.

name: Sunshot
description: A solar hand cannon that makes defeated enemies explode, setting off chains of fiery detonations.

name: Parasite
description: A grenade launcher that fires a living Hive worm; its blast grows with preceding kills.

name: Mjölnir
description: Thor's enchanted hammer channels lightning and storms, returns when thrown and follows worthiness enchantments in many versions.

name: Stormbreaker
description: Thor's formidable axe channels his divine lightning and, in the MCU, can summon the Bifrost.

name: All-Black the Necrosword
description: The ancient symbiote blade associated with Gorr can manifest lethal dark constructs and kill gods.

name: Ebony Blade
description: Black Knight's nearly indestructible mystical blade brings overwhelming power at the price of a dangerous blood curse.

name: Mandarin's Ten Rings
description: Powerful ring artifacts with very different comic and film versions, able to unleash exotic effects or kinetic energy waves.

name: Lantern Power Ring
description: An emotion-powered ring creates hard-light constructs limited chiefly by charge, will and imaginative control.

name: Lasso of Truth
description: Wonder Woman's enchanted lasso binds targets and compels truth in many incarnations.

name: Keyblade — Kingdom Key
description: Sora's iconic key-shaped weapon fights Heartless and seals or unlocks supernatural paths, locks and hearts.

name: χ-blade
description: A legendary counterpart to ordinary Keyblades connected to Kingdom Hearts itself and massive cosmic power.

name: Monado
description: Shulk's red energy sword permits visions of possible futures and deploys special arts, changing the flow of combat.

name: Aegis — Pyra / Mythra sword
description: A legendary blade that channels Pyra's fire and Mythra's light while connecting its wielder to a powerful living partner.

name: Master Sword
description: The sacred blade of evil's bane seals darkness, repels evil and unleashes sword beams under certain conditions.

name: Fierce Deity Sword
description: A dramatic double-helix sword that releases powerful beams when wielded in the Fierce Deity form.

name: Soul Calibur
description: A sentient spirit sword made to oppose Soul Edge, it counters corruption but has complex powers and motives of its own.

name: Soul Edge
description: A sentient demonic weapon that devours souls, corrupts bearers and can take different shapes.

name: Buster Sword
description: Cloud's colossal slab-like blade relies on extreme physical power and can be fitted with magical materia.

name: Masamune — Sephiroth
description: Sephiroth's unusually long katana emphasizes exceptional reach and precision in the hands of a superhuman swordsman.

name: Gunblade — Revolver
description: Squall's sword integrates a gun-like trigger that produces extra impact vibration during a slash, rather than firing conventional bullets.

name: Ultima Weapon
description: A recurring family of exceptionally powerful endgame weapons, with distinct mechanics across individual games.

name: Aegis — Shield of Chaos
description: The Infernal shield can block, bull-rush and ricochet between foes; alternate aspects turn it into a bladed disc or other configurations.

name: Varatha — Eternal Spear
description: An ancient spear that thrusts, sweeps, spins and flies back to its bearer after a throw.

name: Exagryph — Adamant Rail
description: An improbable underworld firearm capable of automatic fire and explosive bombardment, with radically different aspects.

name: Coronacht — Heart-Seeking Bow
description: An infernal bow with charged precision shots and volleys; its aspects add homing tracking or magical payloads.

name: Draupnir — Ring
description: A mythic self-replicating ring reimagined as the source of Kratos's endlessly duplicating spear.

name: Angel's Thousand-Year Spear
description: A massive spear manifested by the Angel Devil from an expenditure of one thousand harvested years of human life.

name: Angel's Lifespan Swords
description: Weapons formed from stolen lifespan; greater life expenditure can create increasingly dangerous supernatural blades.

name: Curse Devil Nail Sword
description: Aki's long nail-like sword can trigger a devastating curse after a prescribed sequence of strikes, costing the user lifespan.

name: Crazy Slots
description: Kite's talking clown roulette conjures one of nine random weapons including a scythe or rifle; the wielder cannot freely choose.

name: Kurapika's Chain Jail
description: A conjured restraining chain that can force Zetsu on its target, but is restricted to Phantom Troupe members under a lethal vow.

name: Black March
description: A sentient 13 Month Series needle whose ignition spirit can unleash extraordinary energy when it agrees to activate.

name: Green April
description: A legendary 13 Month Series hook/whip-like weapon known for extending and changing reach drastically.

name: Demon-Slayer Sword
description: Asta's massive anti-magic sword cuts and reflects magic, expanding its dark edge when enhanced.

name: Demon-Dweller Sword
description: Asta's anti-magic sword absorbs and releases magic or anti-magic as ranged slashes.

name: Demon-Destroyer Sword
description: Its Causality Break ability removes the effects of spells by severing their cause-and-effect connection.

name: Demon-Slasher Katana
description: An anti-magic katana that allows Asta to target what he chooses to cut without harming selected allies.

name: Punisher
description: Wolfwood's massive cross conceals a machine gun, a rocket launcher, and ammunition storage; also functions as cover.

name: Angel Arm
description: Vash's extraordinary bio-weapon transformation can release catastrophic directed energy, far beyond an ordinary pistol.

name: Hellsing ARMS .454 Casull
description: Alucard's imposing long-barreled handgun fires specialized anti-monster .454 ammunition.

name: Jackal
description: Alucard's enormous 13 mm handgun is built to tear through supernatural targets with devastating ammunition.

name: Xoris
description: A throwable Corpus glaive that detonates on command and maintains an infinite melee combo duration.

name: Paracesis
description: The Sentient Slayer greatsword gains special damage and resistance-stripping effects against Sentients as it is developed.

name: Stropha
description: A hybrid melee gunblade that delivers powerful point-blank blasts together with its edged attacks.

name: Nataruk
description: A Sentient-related bow with infinite ammunition and powerful charged arrows rewarded for precise release timing.

name: Sword of the Creator
description: Byleth's crest weapon extends into a segmented whip-sword and enables the Ruptured Heaven combat art.

name: Thunderbrand
description: Catherine's Hero's Relic is a paired-striking legendary blade with a unique combat art enabled by its matching Crest.

name: Aymr
description: Edelgard's special axe enables Raging Storm, letting her chain unusually aggressive attacks when properly used.

name: Arata
description: Kakuja-based quinque armor that wraps an investigator in living protective material and enhances physical performance.

name: Arata Proto
description: An experimental form of the Arata armor with formidable protection and severe stress on its wearer.

name: Doujima 1/2
description: A chimera quinque combining properties of multiple kagune types into a versatile sword-shaped weapon.

name: Nutcracker
description: A quinque whose compressed structure expands explosively on contact to tear apart a target.

name: Fueguchi One
description: A curved rinkaku quinque harvested from Ryoko Fueguchi; its flexible form supports whipping cuts.

name: Fueguchi Two
description: A heavy koukaku quinque made from Hinami's father's kakuhou, prized for hard-hitting defense and offense.

name: Scorpion 1/56
description: Suzuya's small bikaku throwing knives, carried in numbers and used for rapid precision volleys.

name: Yukimura 1/3
description: A slender koukaku quinque resembling a sword; used for precise fencing rather than gigantic kagune attacks.

name: Demon Yamada 1
description: A bikaku quinque weapon employed by Koutarou Amon, effective as a heavy melee club-like blade.

name: Kura
description: A koukaku quinque used by Shinohara; a robust combat tool made to withstand violent close encounters.

name: Bokusatsu No. 2
description: A hard-hitting koukaku quinque with a bulky, club-like silhouette designed for close-range demolition.

name: Higher Mind
description: A ukaku quinque used for concentrated Rc-based ranged fire against ghouls.

name: Hollow
description: A ranged ukaku quinque capable of projecting bursts from its Rc-cell weapon core.

name: Melt
description: An ukaku quinque designed around rapid, concentrated projectile attacks.

name: Silver Skull
description: A distinctive ukaku quinque, deployed to deliver piercing Rc-cell projectiles.

name: Rotten Follow
description: A rinkaku quinque with flexible organic attack reach beyond a conventional blade.

name: Douhi
description: An ukaku quinque that emphasizes ranged shooting rather than brute-force cutting.

name: Nagomi 1/3
description: A rinkaku quinque exploiting the extension and flexibility of its kagune source.

name: Hige Onimaru
description: A bikaku quinque suited to powerful close-quarters attacks.

name: Roku 1/3
description: A bikaku quinque with a tail-derived cutting profile.

name: Lantern
description: A bikaku quinque used as a specialized close-combat cutting implement.

name: Kuroiwa Special
description: A durable rinkaku quinque produced for veteran investigator Kuroiwa.

name: Avalon
description: Artoria's sacred scabbard heals its bearer and can isolate them from outside interference in an exceptionally powerful defense.

name: Caliburn
description: The sword of selection releases tremendous holy energy when properly activated, though it is not as durable as Excalibur.

name: Clarent Blood Arthur
description: Mordred channels a furious burst of red lightning-like magical power through Clarent.

name: Arondight
description: Lancelot's divine sword never suffers ordinary wear and dramatically enhances his knightly combat when released.

name: Arondight Overload
description: A concentrated magical overload attack launched through Lancelot's sacred blade.

name: Durandal
description: Hector's unbreakable legendary spear-sword, associated with powerful thrown attacks and immense durability.

name: Joyeuse Ordre
description: Charlemagne's sacred sword unleashes a magnificent light-based Noble Phantasm.

name: La Pucelle
description: Jeanne d'Arc's final flame manifests as a self-sacrificial, overwhelming holy attack.

name: Láegarn
description: Saber Sigurd's magical greatsword supports colossal runic swordplay and devastating throws.

name: Gram
description: Sigurd's dragon-slaying blade, a demonic sword of extraordinary quality and raw magical power.

name: Fafnir's Blood Armor
description: Siegfried's protective dragon blood renders most attacks ineffective except at a vulnerable spot; a defense rather than a sword.

name: Gungnir
description: Odin's legendary spear is depicted in Type-Moon lore as a divine prototype of later spear legends.

name: Gáe Bolg Alternative
description: Scáthach's version of the cursed spear technique combines penetrating attacks with tremendous magical spikes.

name: Gáe Bolg — Soaring Spear
description: Cú Chulainn throws his spear in a wide-area lethal attack, distinct from the causality-reversing thrust.

name: Vajra
description: An Indra-associated thunderbolt weapon, manifesting electrical divine force.

name: Tsumukari Muramasa
description: Muramasa's ultimate forged blade cuts through complicated bonds and phenomena with an all-or-nothing sword strike.

name: Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi
description: A divine Japanese sword wielded by multiple servants in different interpretations, projecting extraordinary sacred cutting force.

name: Ascalon
description: Georgios's holy weapon becomes extraordinarily effective against foes identified as dragons.

name: Ascalon — Dragon Transformation
description: An associated Noble Phantasm can bestow the dragon trait on a target, enabling anti-dragon punishment.

name: Laevatein
description: A fiery divine sword linked with the Surtr legend and apocalyptic destruction.

name: Marmyadose
description: A sword linked to the Arthurian tradition whose physical force can surpass even certain sacred blades.

name: Hrunting
description: A cursed or pursuit-oriented blade in Fate adaptations; EMIYA can launch it as a tracking Broken Phantasm arrow.

name: Caladbolg II
description: EMIYA reshapes a mythical sword into a powerful spiral arrow, detonating an area on impact.

name: Unlimited Blade Works
description: EMIYA's Reality Marble reproduces and stores countless observed bladed weapons; a supernatural armory rather than one sword.

name: Gate of Babylon
description: Gilgamesh's treasury opens spatial portals to rain down legendary prototype weapons; technically a treasury ability.

name: Nine Lives
description: Heracles' extraordinary combat technique can unleash rapid multi-strike assaults with different weapons.

name: Rho Aias
description: A seven-layered floral defensive shield especially powerful against thrown weapons.

name: Lord Camelot
